text: dsh-skill-slash-fuzzy 是 DSH 的技能斜杠匹配插件，适用于 Web 客户端。它在 agent/pre-step 阶段读取当前技能目录，并把用户消息中能唯一对应技能名称的短斜杠词元改写为完整名称；精确名称和有歧义的片段保持原样。浏览器输入菜单还会提供按前缀、名称片段和模糊字符匹配排序的技能候选，选择后补全完整技能名。适合技能名称较长、希望用短片段调用或搜索技能的 DSH 用户。安装需 Node.js 22 或更高版本，并通过 DSH 插件命令添加。

dsh-skill-slash-fuzzy helps DSH web users find and invoke skills by short slash fragments. It expands a unique match to the full skill name, preserves exact or ambiguous tokens, and ranks fuzzy candidates in the input menu. Requires Node.js 22+ and DSH plugin installation.
想用技能名的一小段斜杠命令调用完整技能。
在输入框里按技能名称片段搜索并补全技能。
I want short slash tokens to resolve to a skill when the matching name fragment is unique.
dsh-skill-slash-fuzzy 的功能「唯一片段调用」：在用户消息发送前匹配技能名称，把唯一对应的斜杠词元替换为完整技能名；名称精确匹配或片段有歧义时不改写。
dsh-skill-slash-fuzzy 的功能「技能菜单模糊搜索」：在输入框输入斜杠和名称片段后显示排序候选，优先列出前缀及完整名称片段匹配；选择候选会填入完整技能名。

dsh-skill-slash-fuzzy README · dsh-skill-slash-fuzzy：Official skill slash matching is exact-name `startsWith`. Host commands already fuzzy-match. This plugin fills the gap for kebab-case skills: `/oneshot` can load `game-package-oneshot` when that segment is unique.

dsh-skill-slash-fuzzy README · Install：From GitHub (no build step — `lib/` is the source):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:NecromanAlbert/dsh-skill-slash-fuzzy
```

Or a local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-skill-slash-fuzzy
```

Restart the Desktop GUI after install.

dsh-skill-slash-fuzzy README · What it does：| | |
| --- | --- |
| Host | Rewrites unique `/segment` tokens to the full skill name before official injection |
| Client | Extra `/` source so unique segments appear in the skill menu |
| Unique hit | `/oneshot` → `game-package-oneshot` |
| Ambiguous | `/package` stays `/package` when two skills share that segment |
| Exact names | `/pua` and `/understand` are unchanged |

dsh-skill-slash-fuzzy README · What this is not：- Not a replacement for official `ui-skill` or `dsh-tool-skill`.
- Not a fuzzy matcher for host commands (those already fuzzy-match).
- Not an alias registry. There is no extra YAML of nicknames.

dsh-skill-slash-fuzzy README · Develop：```sh
node --test
```

Host: `lib/index.js` (`agent/pre-step` waterfall).  
Client: `lib/client.js` (`window.__ModuleLoader__`, extra `/` source `skill-fuzzy`).  
Shared: `lib/match.js`.
